notifications.taskDoneHint: Get a push on this phone when a task on your computer finishes, fails, or needs your reply. Completion and reply alerts include the latest response.
notifications.permissionDenied: Notifications are turned off in system settings. Allow notifications in iOS Settings → Notifications → {{appName}}, then try again.
notifications.unregisterQueued: Turned off. Could not unregister on the current network; it will finish automatically next time you're online.

about.deviceNameDetail: This name appears in the authorization list on your computer.
about.remoteControlDetail: This phone acts only as a controller. Granting, revoking, and restoring control permissions is done in desktop settings.

relay.reconnectHint: Remote sessions will resubscribe automatically when the network recovers.
relay.resumeHint: The connection resumes when you return to the app or sign in again.

legal.analyticsHint: Helps us understand how often Cindy is launched and kept in use. Reports device and usage-environment information — such as your device model, OS version, app version, and a device identifier — plus, once signed in, your account ID; never conversations, files, or prompts.
legal.analyticsSaveFailed: Couldn't save this setting; it may revert after a restart.

account.logoutHint: Signing out only clears the sign-in state and local remote mirror on this phone. Sessions on your computer are not affected.

voiceDictionary.label: View dictionary
voiceDictionary.hint: Your dictionary lives on your computers and syncs between them automatically. This is a read-only view — add or remove terms on a computer.
voiceDictionary.readOnlyHint: Read-only here — add or remove terms on a computer.
voiceDictionary.offlineHint: None of your computers are online. Showing what was last synced to your phone.
voiceDictionary.noDesktops: No computers yet. Sign in on a computer with the same account and your dictionary will show up here.
